title: Exploring hidden natural resources for bioactive compounds: Focused chemical and biological studies on some Anthemis species.
authors: Zheleva-Dimitrova, Dimitrina; Gevrenova, Reneta; Yagi, Sakina; Cetiz, Mehmet Veysi; Yildiztugay, Evren; Gulcin, Ilhami; Yapici, Ismail; Di Simone, Simonetta Cristina; Orlando, Giustino; Menghini, Luigi; Ferrante, Claudio; Chiavaroli, Annalisa; Zengin, Gokhan
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Anthemis植物提取物的化学成分与生物活性，仅涉及分子对接与转录因子的泛泛互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: The present study investigated the phytochemical composition and biological activities of extracts from the aerial parts of Anthemis austriaca, A. cretica subsp. albida, A. pauciloba, A. tinctoria and A. wiedemanniana. About 150 compounds belonging to hydroxybenzoic acids, hydroxycinnamic acids, phenylethanoid glycosides, acylquinic acids, acylhexaric acids, flavonoids and sesquiterpene lactones were identified. A. tinctoria also displayed significant antiradical activity, obtained from its MeOH and 70 % MeOH extracts. EtOAc and MeOH extracts of A. pauciloba revealed the highest anti-acetylcholinesterase activity (3.51 and 3.50 mg GALAE/g; p > 0.05). Extracts had a higher affinity towards human carbonic anhydrase isoenzymes I (CAI) than CAII, and the best inhibition effect was exerted by EtOAc extract of A. wiedemanniana a (IC(50) 7.02 mug/mL). Network pharmacology analysis identified IL6 and TNFalpha as key targets of these plant-derived molecules, underscoring their multi-target potential. Anthemis extracts' efficacy in blunting LPS-induced IL6 and TNFalpha gene expression in isolated mouse colon has confirmed these predictions. Molecular docking studies further confirmed that these compounds interact with multiple transcription factors (TFs), suggesting broad pharmacological activity. These results indicated that the five Anthemis species could be a promising source of bioactive molecules.
abstract_zh: 本研究调查了五种春黄菊属植物（Anthemis austriaca、A. cretica subsp. albida、A. pauciloba、A. tinctoria 和 A. wiedemanniana）地上部分提取物的植物化学成分及生物活性。共鉴定出约150种化合物，分属羟基苯甲酸、羟基肉桂酸、苯乙醇苷、酰基奎宁酸、酰基己糖酸、黄酮类及倍半萜内酯类。A. tinctoria 的甲醇和70%甲醇提取物表现出显著的抗自由基活性。A. pauciloba 的乙酸乙酯和甲醇提取物显示出最高的抗乙酰胆碱酯酶活性（3.51 和 3.50 mg GALAE/g；p > 0.05）。各提取物对人碳酸酐酶同工酶I（CAI）的亲和力高于CAII，其中 A. wiedemanniana a 的乙酸乙酯提取物表现出最佳抑制效果（IC(50) 7.02 μg/mL）。网络药理学分析确定IL6和TNFα为这些植物来源分子的关键靶点，凸显了其多靶点潜力。春黄菊属提取物在离体小鼠结肠中抑制LPS诱导的IL6和TNFα基因表达的功效证实了这些预测。分子对接研究进一步确认这些化合物与多种转录因子（TFs）相互作用，提示其具有广泛的药理活性。这些结果表明，五种春黄菊属植物可能是生物活性分子的有前景来源。
